scope: DM publishes use NDK 3.0.3's default 2.5 s per-relay ack timeout, so under load a DM the relay stores is rolled back on the sender (bubble vanishes, text restored, resend duplicates at the peer); groups use 10 s. Plus the failed-send UX decided by Fable 2026-10-18 (option b).

behavior.timeout: One shared constant PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000 in ndkClient.ts (same value as NdkNetworkAdapter.rawPublish) and a helper that publishes an NDKEvent with it. Every user-initiated DM publish on the chat surface (ContactChat text + reaction; directMessages.ts send/reaction/removal/delete/edit replacement+companion) goes through it — no bare ndkEvent.publish() left there. Out of scope: pairing, dmProfile, calls, backup, marmot (own timeouts/semantics).
behavior.genuine_failure: Unchanged rollback (bubble removed, text back in the composer, reaction rollback). NEW (Fable AGENT-DECIDES, DMs and groups alike): ChatBox shows an inline notice above the composer in the same slot/style as imageSendFailed, testid message-send-failed, text copy.groups.messageSendFailed, with the existing Retry link (copy.groups.imageRetry, testid message-retry-button) that calls handleSend() on the restored text. Cleared at the start of the next send attempt.

tests: Unit: the publish helper passes PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_MS (>= 10_000) to NDK, and a relay ack arriving after 2.5 s but before the timeout resolves successfully (fails before the fix).
Unit (pure-function extraction, no jsdom): the send-failure state transitions (set on text-send failure, cleared on next attempt).
Existing unit + tsc green; full e2e gate green.
non_goals: Persisted 'unsent' bubble state / offline queue (option c)
